mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% YoY signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS YoY decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO YoY increase does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative monetary policy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent market strength.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE is below 4% and PAYEMS is increasing by more than 200k jobs per month, it signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of low UNRATE and high PAYEMS growth does not correlate with subsequent market strength.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances with HOUST YoY > 10%, or HOUST YoY increase does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of low GDPC1 growth and declining INDPRO does not correlate with subsequent market weakness.
